That's What Sea Said by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 Welcome to That's What Sea Said. The unique third-floor deck, a great place to unwind and enjoy the views, is almost as wonderful as the community pool and grilling area. The first floor is open and spacious, with abundant seating for the entire family in the inviting living room. There’s also a primary bedroom, king, and a guest room, queen, which features a seating area and mini fridge with shared bath. The second floor has a fully stocked kitchen with a dining area and seating for 6 with 4 additional bar stools. Beside the dining area is another living area for the family to watch TV.

The second floor also features a bedroom with two full beds and two twin beds directly above. The 2nd-floor floor bedroom has a hall bathroom. The third floor has a second primary bedroom, king, with private bath. Nearby is guest room with two queen beds and a private bath. A spiral staircase leads to the third-floor deck, a great place to unwind and enjoy the views. Welcome! Our dedicated team at Oversee 30A, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 695 steps (.3 miles) to the beach (Blue Mountain Regional Access) - 4 bedrooms, 4 baths - 2464 sq ft - Community grill - Heated community pool - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Parking limited to two vehicles Overnight: - Queen in 1st floor guest room; shared bath - Two fulls on 2nd floor and two twins above; shared bath - King in 3rd floor primary bedroom; private bath - Two queens in third-floor guest room; private bath Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
